title: All Continuous Data Lost Error
detail_of_failure: All data lost error occurs in the engine controller.
machine_effect: • Engine stops and cannot start in some cases. • Monitoring function (engine controller system) of the machine monitor does not operate normally in some cases.
related_information: After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check if other failure codes are shown at the same time. If other codes are shown, do the troubleshooting for them.

steps.cause: Do the troubleshooting for failure code [CA441].
